title: Gentle Mary Laid Her Child
description: Gentle Mary Laid Her Child in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 3 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Joseph Simpson Cook, first published in 1919. The tune, TEMPUS ADEST FLORIDUM, is from Swedish Piae Cantones, 1582. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Gen-tle Ma-ry laid her Child low-ly in a man-ger; There He lay, the un-de-filed, to the world a Stran-ger: Such a Babe in such a place, can He be the Sa-vior? Ask the saved of all the race who have found His fa_-vor.

lines: Such a Babe in such a place,
Ask the saved of all the race
wise men sought and found Him;
All the plains were lit that night,
Son of God, of humble birth,
Praise His Name in all the earth,
